references.text: This is a direct parallel text confirming the same historical transition of kingship in Edom.
Continues the same chronological list of Edomite kings and places Samla in its historical context.
Contains an earlier part of the same list of Edomite kings and emphasizes the pattern of changing rulers.
Another link in the same chain of Edomite kings confirming the history of Edom's independent rulers.
Describes the earlier transition to Hadad, who dies in the source verse, and shows the connection in the king list.
Describes the transition from Hadad to Ba'al-Hanan, which is part of the same historical list as the source verse.
